usage: perplexity-health.py [-h] [--browser-available] [--app-path APP_PATH]
                            [--write] [--format {md,json}]
                            [config]

positional arguments:
  config               Path to seo-cycle.yaml

options:
  -h, --help           show this help message and exit
  --browser-available  Mark an already logged-in browser/app session as
                       usable.
  --app-path APP_PATH  Additional Perplexity.app path to test.
  --write              Write seo/setup/perplexity-health.* artifacts.
  --format {md,json}
